icon.description: A plain icon before the resting label.

prompt.description: The question while confirming, such as "Delete 3 files?". Defaults to the label with a question mark.

pendingLabel.description: Shown beside the spinner while onConfirm resolves.

retryLabel.description: Retry button label on the error face.

undoingLabel.description: Shown beside the spinner while onUndo resolves.

tone.description: danger colours the resting label and confirm button red; neutral uses the foreground.

onConfirm.description: Runs on confirm. Return a promise to show the pending face; a rejection shows the error face with Retry.

onUndo.description: Adds Undo to the result. Return a promise to show a pending face while it runs.

onCancel.description: Called when the question is cancelled, including by Escape, outside press, or timeout.

state.description: Controlled state. Pair it with onStateChange.

confirmTimeout.description: Milliseconds before an unanswered question returns to rest. Hovering pauses it; 0 turns it off.

resultTimeout.description: Milliseconds a result stays before returning to rest. Hovering pauses it; 0 turns it off.

cancelOnOutsidePress.description: A press outside the control cancels an open question.

ref.description: The root element, which also takes focus while the action is pending.
